title: VIP
description: The account VIP system. Accumulating VIP XP (earned mainly by using VIP Points / activity) raises the VIP level, unlocking shop access, bonuses and perks. This file records the VIP XP values shown in-game for each level.
sources: User-provided in-game VIP XP table screenshot (2026-07-20).

entries.name: VIP XP requirements
entries.summary: VIP XP value listed for each VIP level, from VIP 1 (base, no requirement) up to VIP 12. VIP 1 shows '-' (no XP needed / starting level).

details.note: VIP 1 is the starting level and shows '-' in-game (recorded as null). The source table does not label whether the number is the XP needed to reach that level from the previous one (per-level) or the cumulative total XP; kept verbatim as shown. See open_questions.

entries.name: Daily VIP points collection
entries.summary: There is a daily VIP points claim that must be collected each day to avoid losing the daily bonus. Simple recurring daily action — a good automation candidate.

details.why: Missing the daily collection forfeits that day's VIP progress/bonus.
details.automation_note: Fixed daily claim; pairs with the other daily routines (decrees, nomadic merchant).

open_questions: Is the 'xp' value per-level (XP to advance from the previous level) or the cumulative total XP threshold?
Perks/bonuses unlocked at each VIP level and how VIP XP is earned (VIP Points sources).
